crossRefs.note: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.
He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.
My anguish, my anguish! I am pained at my very heart! My heart trembles within me. I can’t hold my peace, because you…

translations.web: He said to his father, “My head! My head!” He said to his servant, “Carry him to his mother.”
translations.bsb: “My head! My head!” he complained to his father. So his father told a servant, “Carry him to his mother.”
translations.kjv: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.
translations.asv: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to his servant, Carry him to his mother.
